Name: stanloona420's Leah Revised for 1.6
Author: manzanaOnline
Description:
It replaces the original beach and regular portraits/sprites and adds a replacement winter version, taken from the seasonal version of the original mod. I tested the indoor/outdoor outfit change mechanic and didn't encounter any problems, but please tell me if you do or if you have any suggestions.

[size=4][b]Installation instructions[/b][/size]
Extract the files from the .zip file into your Mods folder. You need to have Content Patcher installed. That's it!

[size=4][b]Requirements[/b][/size]
Content Patcher
